origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Abyssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: He mea ola o ka hohonu - ʻaʻahu ʻia, wikiwiki i ka wai, a hiki iā ia ke kāhea i nā hoa kiaʻi.Mālie a maloʻo ma ka ʻāina.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Hanu i ka wai e like me ka ea a ʻike pono ma loko ona me ka ʻole o ka noe.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: ʻO nā mines i ka wikiwiki holoʻokoʻa i ka wā i hoʻopaʻa ʻia.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o ka neʻe ʻana ma ka wai.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Wai hāmama
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: 'Au'au 'au'au 'o ia ma waho o ke kai, 'a'ole ma laila wale nō.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Kūleʻa Kūʻē
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: Paʻa i ka hohonu i ka wā i hoʻokomo pono ʻia ma mua o ke pohō.Ke hana mau nei ka ʻauʻau ʻana i lalo.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Pescivore
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Hiki ke ʻai i ka iʻa wale nō.Hiki i nā mea lawelawe ke hoʻopau i kēia ma ka config (ocean_origins.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: ʻO ka cod maka a me ka salmon ka meaʻai e like me nā ʻano moʻa.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Ke neʻe nei i loko o ka wai me nā hahau ikaika a maikaʻi - ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki ma mua o ka mea noho i luna.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Hoʻopili ʻia nā maka i ka pouli loa.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Hoʻihoʻi i 30% o ka pōʻino i loaʻa i ka poʻe hoʻouka.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 puʻuwai (+4 max HP).Kūkulu ʻia ke ʻano o ke kai hohonu i kahi ʻano paʻakikī.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: ʻO nā mines me ka māmā holoʻokoʻa ʻoiai i ka wā i loko.
Ho'ōla mālie i loko o ka wai - ma kahi o 1 HP i kēlā me kēia 3 kekona.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: Lawe ʻia he 1.5 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona ke ʻike ʻia i ka lā.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_land_speed_pena: E neʻe 10% mālie ma ka ʻāina.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Māloʻo
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Piʻi ka ea ma waho o ka wai: lōʻihi loa ka ʻili a ʻeha ʻoe.ʻO ka ua, ka ipu wai, ka hanu wai a i ʻole kahi auwai hana kokoke e hoʻopaʻa iā ia.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Voidwalker
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: ʻO kahi i hoʻopā ʻia e ka Hopena - e hele ana ma waena o nā poloka, e ʻālohilohi i kahi mamao pōkole, a hele i ka ʻike ʻole ʻia e ka hapa nui o nā mea hoʻoweliweli.ʻO ka holo ʻana me ka luhi ʻole, akā he ʻeha ka wai.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Pīhoihoi i kahi āu e nānā nei (a hiki i 24 mau poloka).Koina 2 ikehu.80-tick cooldown.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Hiki ke ʻike i ka pōʻeleʻele loa.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
ʻAʻole ʻike ʻo Mobs i kou hele ʻana ke ʻole ʻoe e hoʻouka iā lākou.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Lawe i 1 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona i loko o ka wai a i ʻole ka ua - makaʻu ka mea ʻole i ka wai.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: ʻAʻohe pōloli keu ka uku o ka sprinting.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Kiaʻi pōhaku
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: Hānau ʻia me ka pōhaku ola - he kiaʻi hoʻoluliluli ʻole nāna e hoʻolei i nā kākalaioa i ka poʻe hoʻouka kaua, e mine i ka pōhaku me nā lima ʻole, a hoʻonoho i nā lama kukui i loko o ka pōʻeleʻele.ʻAʻole haʻalele ka ʻāina lohi, akā naʻe.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 puʻuwai (+6 max HP).ʻOi aku ka paʻa o ke kino pōhaku ma mua o ka ʻiʻo.
Hoʻihoʻi i 20% o ka pōʻino i loaʻa i nā mea hoʻouka.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_slow_movemen: Neʻe 10% lohi ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Wehe i nā poloka ʻelua wikiwiki.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: ʻAʻole hoʻomaka nā monsters i loko o 48 mau poloka.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: ʻeleʻele
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: ʻO kahi ʻano ola o ka honua ʻōmaʻomaʻo - pau ʻole, me ka maluhia me ka hihiu, akā ua luku loa ʻia e ka palaho ʻo Nether.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: ʻO nā poʻe lehulehu a pau - me ka poʻe ʻenemi - e haʻalele iā ʻoe ke ʻole e hoʻonāukiuki ʻia.
Hoʻopili nā aʻa i kēlā me kēia hāʻule.ʻAʻole lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.verdant_no_hunger_sprin: ʻAʻohe pōloli keu ka uku o ka sprinting.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Hoʻoulu lohi i ke olakino ʻoiai i loko o nā biomes nahele.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: Lawe i 2 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona i ka Nether.Kāohi loa nā kāmaʻa Frost Walker i ka pōʻino.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: ʻO kahi keiki o ke aka - hoʻolei i nā ʻōpuni o ka ikehu ʻeleʻele, kaʻi ma waena o nā kūlana, a pale i nā pua.Holo i ka pōʻeleʻele, puhi ʻia e ka lā.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: ʻIke pono i ka pōʻeleʻele.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: ʻO ka Shadow Dash
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Huhū i mua me ka wikiwiki nui ma ke ala āu e neʻe nei.Koina 2 ikehu.60-tick cooldown.
Lawe i 1 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona ke ʻike ʻia i ka lā pololei.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: Holo ʻino nā pua ma kāu ʻano i hoʻopā ʻia i ke aka.
power.neoorigins.umbral_no_hunger_sprint: ʻAʻohe pōloli keu ka uku o ka sprinting.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Orb Malu
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: E kau i kahi orb i ʻike ʻole ʻia e hoʻolei i kahi radius 28-pākaʻi i loko o ka Poʻeleʻele.A hiki i 4 orbs e hana i ka manawa hoʻokahi;ʻo ke kau ʻana i kahi mea hou e wehe i ka mea kahiko.Koina 2 ikehu.60-tick cooldown.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: Punces ikaika iā ʻoe ma ke ala āu e ʻimi nei.Koina 2 ikehu.4-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Eheu Dragon
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Holo manuahi ma ka lewa me ka hoʻohana ʻana i nā ʻēheu draconic ikaika.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Hanu i ka pohā o 4 mau pōpō ahi liʻiliʻi ma ke ala āu e nānā nei.He 3 ka ikaika.4-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Pomaikai o ke Natura
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o nā mea kanu kokoke i kou alo, me he mea lā ua hoʻopōmaikaʻi ʻia e ka ʻāina.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Hoʻopili
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Hoʻopau i nā mea ola kokoke i kahi me ka Slowness VI ikaika no 4 kekona.Koina 2 ola.200-tick cooldown.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: E hele ana ma ka paia paʻa ma ke ala āu e nānā nei.3-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: E puhi ana i ka ikehu maloo e pahū ana i kahi o ka noe ino.Koina 1 ikehu.4-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: Hāʻawi ʻia i kahi trident enchanted ikaika (Mending, Unbreaking III, Riptide III) ke koho ʻoe i kēia kumu.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: ʻO nā mea holo moana - hee, iʻa, dolphins - e holo aku mai ou aku.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: E hoʻokahe i ka pā paʻa ma ke ala āu e nānā nei.Koina 3 ikehu.80-tick cooldown.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Hoʻonoho i kahi poloka pōhaku ʻālohilohi ma ka ʻili āu e nānā nei.100-tick cooldown.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: ʻO ka uhaki ʻana i nā mea kanu oʻo a i ʻole nā lāʻau e hoʻohua i hoʻokahi pūʻulu kulu.
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.max_reach: Ua kāhea ʻia nā minions kiʻekiʻe!
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.not_enoug: ʻAʻole lawa ka pōloli e kiʻi ai!
item.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.not_enough: Pono ʻoe %s pae ʻike e hoʻohana i kēia.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Hoʻihoʻi hou i nā koho kumu āpau a wehe hou i ka mea koho kumu.Nā kumukūʻai 5 XP pae no ka hoʻohana mua ʻana (noa ka hoʻohana mua ʻana).Hoʻohana ʻia ma ka hoʻohana ʻana.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Hoʻihoʻi hou i nā koho kumu āpau a wehe hou i ka mea koho kumu.Nā kumukūʻai 5 XP pae no ka hoʻohana mua ʻana (noa ka hoʻohana mua ʻana).Hoʻohana ʻia ma ka hoʻohana ʻana.
item.neoorigins.orb_of_class.not_enough_: Pono ʻoe %s pae ʻike e hoʻohana i kēia.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Hoʻihoʻi hou i kāu koho papa wale nō a wehe hou i ka mea koho papa, e mālama ana i kāu kumu kumu.Koina 2 XP pae no ka hoohana ana.Hoʻohana ʻia ma ka hoʻohana ʻana.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Hoʻihoʻi hou i kāu koho papa wale nō a wehe hou i ka mea koho papa, e mālama ana i kāu kumu kumu.Koina 2 XP pae no ka hoohana ana.Hoʻohana ʻia ma ka hoʻohana ʻana.
origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Inchling
origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: ʻO ka humanoid ka nui o ka hapaha e hoʻonui i nā paia me ka maʻalahi a neʻe me ka wikiwiki kamahaʻo - akā hele mai ke kino palupalu me ka ʻāina.
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.name: liʻiliʻi
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.descripti: He hapahā wale nō o ka nui maʻamau.
Hiki ke pipili a hoʻonui i kēlā me kēia ʻili.
power.neoorigins.inchling_reduced_health: -5 puʻuwai (-10 max HP).He hapaha ka nui o ka hoʻopaʻi.
power.neoorigins.inchling_speed_boost.de: ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o 15% ma mua o ka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: Pōloli ka hapalua e like me ka mea pāʻani maʻamau.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Sporeling
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: He mea leʻaleʻa e ulu ana i ka pōʻeleʻele a me nā māla ʻala - paʻa me nā spores ʻawaʻawa, akā maloʻo i ka lā.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: Hoʻā i kahi mea hoʻoheheʻe spore e hū aʻe i loko o ke ao lōʻihi o nā spores ʻona.Koina 3 olaola.12-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_poison_immuni: Palekana i nā hopena make a pau.
Hiki ke ʻike maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
